remarks: Welcome to your new home! This fully renovated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath beauty is tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, just over a mile from the beach in a top-rated, award-winning school district.  Inside, you'll love the bright, open layout, updated kitchen, and modern finishes throughout. There's plenty of space to relax, entertain, and make memories. The bedrooms are spacious and comfortable, including a primary suite that feels like a true retreat.  You're close to everything here - Metro-North, shopping, restaurants, parks, and of course, the beach! Whether you're commuting, grabbing coffee with friends, or heading out for a day of sun and surf, everything you need is just around the corner.  Move right in and start enjoying the easy, coastal lifestyle you've been dreaming about!
